claim: Bangs fluorescent microsphere suspensions covered by PDS 731 contain sodium azide.
validity_conditions: The concentration is not given in PDS 731; the Safety Data Sheet would hold it and was not read. The sheet's disposal note: azide can form explosive metal azides with lead or copper plumbing, so flush with a large volume of water. This is knowledge about the product; handling rules are the person's. Azide also matters to any biological sample mixed with these beads. Type-level: about the product as supplied, not about a bottle on this bench until its catalogue and lot numbers are read. RENAMED 2026-10-07 under task 047, same claim, value, source and grade (rule 8: a rename is not a supersede): identifiers.catalogue_product became catalog_numbers_listed, not addressable, because it holds a range or a list and not one catalogue number; the line is addressed instead by product = 'Fluorescent Microspheres', the vendor's own name for it as printed in this entry's source, which is a class handle and not an item.
